mapper.sql:
SELECT t.schedule_id AS scheduleId, t.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, t.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, t.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, t.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, t.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, t.start_time AS startTime, t.end_time AS endTime, t.capacity AS capacity, t.reserved_count AS reservedCount, t.signed_count AS signedCount, t.reservation_deadline AS reservationDeadline, t.cancel_deadline AS cancelDeadline, t.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, t.schedule_mode AS scheduleMode, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(m.real_name, m.nickname) ORDER BY ss2.member_id SEPARATOR '、')
FROM fit_schedule_student ss2 INNER JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = ss2.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE ss2.schedule_id = t.schedule_id AND ss2.del_flag = '0') AS studentNames, t.remark AS remark, t.create_time AS createTime

FROM fit_course_schedule t LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = t.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = t.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_course_schedule SET reserved_count = CASE WHEN reserved_count + #{delta} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE reserved_count + #{delta} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0' AND (reserved_count + #{delta} >= 0) AND (#{delta} <= 0 OR reserved_count < capacity OR capacity IS NULL)
UPDATE fit_course_schedule SET signed_count = CASE WHEN signed_count + #{delta} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE signed_count + #{delta} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT course_type FROM fit_course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fit_schedule_student( tenant_id, schedule_id, member_id, attendance_status, remind_status, create_time, update_time, del_flag ) VALUES
(#{tenantId}, #{scheduleId}, #{memberId}, 'pending', '0', NOW(), NOW(), '0')
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM fit_schedule_student WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY member_id ASC
